klu chog gdengs can 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na maḥshri gu ra we/'dir bde phag lta bu'i spros bcas sgrub mchod kyi rim pa rdzogs nas rdul

tei:div.tei:p: klu chog gdengs can 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshri gu ra we/ 'dir bde phag lta bu'i spros bcas sgrub mchod kyi rim pa rdzogs nas rdul tshon chu bor gshegs pa'i lag len mdo tsam spel ba la sbyor ba yo byad kyi gshoms dang*/ dngos gzhi cho ga'i bya ba'o// dang po ni/ rdul tshon gyi bum pa dang mchod pa la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas nas slob dpon slob mar bcas pas dril spos kyis sna drangs pa'i bkur bsti dang bcas te rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bo'am/ mtsho dang chu mig sogs skam par mi 'gyur bar rgyun du gnas pa'i chu 'gram du maṇḍal lta bu'i gzhi'am rdo leb la dri dang tshon dkar pos padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus dang 'dab ma la me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/ klu sman btab pa'i 'o ma/ sbrang rtsi sogs dkar mngar gyis sbags pa'i gtor ma dang*/ de'i rgyab mdun gang 'os kyi stegs bu mtho ba la rdul tshon bzhugs su gsol la/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas mchod pa rnams bde mchog skabs khaṇḍaros bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod sogs nas arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis byin gyis brlab dgos/ mchan/ bighnān gyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las sogs nas/ rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bar gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ slar yang rten bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las waṃ las byung ba'i rgya mtsho rin po che dang me tog gis gang ba'i dbus su padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥlas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar gsal zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon padma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan can mtshan dpe'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa'o// thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas klu chen brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/

'dab ma brgyad la 'khod pa ni/ shar du mtha' yas dkar po utpal 'dzin pa/ lhor padma dmar po padma 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'jog po dmar po dgra sta 'dzin pa/ byang du nor rgyas ser po bum pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du pad chen dkar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ shar lho dung skyong ser po dung phor 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu karko ṭa nag po sbrul 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rigs ldan dkar po rin po che'i rkyal bu 'dzin pa ste/ thams cad kyang lte ba yan chad khye'u'i gzugs can/ lus smad lto 'gro'i mjug ma dang/ mgo bor gdengs ka dang ldan zhing*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'khor dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ oṃ ma ti padme hūm̐/ aṣṭa nā ga a dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab 'joms shing*// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// lag g.yon gdengs ka'i tshul dang*/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi rgyas/ oṃ a nan ta/ ba su ki/ takṣa ka /karko ṭa ka /padma/ ma hā padma/ shaṃ kha pā la/ ku li ka /de ba tī/ ma hā de ba tī/ so ma shi khi/ ma hā shi khi/ daṇḍa dha ra/ ma hā daṇṭa dha ra/ a ba lā la/ hu lu na ta/ nan da/ u pa nan da/ sā ga ra/ ma hā sā ga ra/ tapta/ ma hā tapta/ shrī kān ti/ ma hā kān ti/ ratna kānti/ su rū pa/ ma hā su rū pa/ bha dra hi ka /ma ho ra ga /shi li/ ma hā shi li/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa ā gatstsha a gatstsha/ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ti sarba bhur bhu wa phruṃ phu swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces dang/ klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ deng de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdul tshon rin po che'i rang bzhin 'di rnams bdag gir mdzad nas mchod pa dang*/

'jig rten gyi khams spyi dang khyad par sa phyogs 'di dag tu bde legs kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol// zhes sogs skabs su bab pa'i phrin las gsol nas/ che ba'i che mchog gam/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyis shis pa brjod/ yig brgya dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang bde mchog skabs gang yang bdag blo sogs mchan/ sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyi mthar/ gatstsha gatstsha swa bhā wa nāṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muṃḥ zhes pas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas klu rnams gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs thugs rje chen po rang la bstim/ rdul tshon dang mchod gtor rnams rim bzhin chur dor/ gzhi'i maṇḍal gyi tshom bu rnams tshur gshegs shing re khā yang 'khru/ tshon snod kyi bum pa chu gtsang gis bkang nas/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhi lo tsa ne sarba artha sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes spyan ma'i sngags bzla bzhin dkyil 'khor khang pa sogs la bkra shis pa'i phyir bsang gtor bya zhing phyogs thams cad du bde legs kyi snang ba chen pos yongs su khyab par bya'o// zhes klu chog gdengs can 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di na ི khungs ldan yig rnying gi dgongs pa bzhin si tu padma'i ming gis don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gi ngor dpal spungs yang dben nas spel ba maṅga lam/// /
